revision.statement: The router contract is versioned per release train instead of per build.
revision.rationale: Per-build versioning made every consumer re-pin on unrelated changes
assumptions: Release trains keep their current cadence

relations.rationale: The per-build decision no longer describes the shipped router contract
supports: The release-train decision replaces it in full

evidence.supports: The superseding decision names its predecessor
evidence.interpretation: The target keeps its accepted Git facts; only the projection derives superseded_by
limitations: The derived state is local to one projection
